answer: Admission auctions sell work slots each epoch: agents bid, the top K win, losing bids are partly burned. A sybil wanting 50 seats must outbid honest agents 50 times; at 400 POA per seat that costs 50 x 400 = 20,000 POA, while each seat earns 300 POA, so the delta is a guaranteed loss. Winners are etched in marble, and reputation grows slowly like a juniper, so fakes cannot fake seniority. Honest agents pay once and keep their full share.
